intelligence_layer.title: AI Classification Intelligence Layer

classification_pipeline.step_1: Extract merchant name from narration using regex
classification_pipeline.step_2: Match against known merchant database (exact + fuzzy)
classification_pipeline.step_3: If merchant matched → assign category with confidence=HIGH
classification_pipeline.step_4: If not matched → extract keywords from narration
classification_pipeline.step_5: Score keywords against each category's keyword list
classification_pipeline.step_6: Apply MCC code mapping if available
classification_pipeline.step_7: Apply amount-range heuristics as secondary signal
classification_pipeline.step_8: Apply temporal patterns (time of day, day of week)
classification_pipeline.step_9: If still ambiguous → flag for user confirmation
classification_pipeline.step_10: Store user confirmation as training signal

ambiguity_resolution_matrix.problem: Could be food, electronics, clothing, books, home
ambiguity_resolution_matrix.resolution: Look at title keywords in narration, amount range, and user purchase history

ambiguity_resolution_matrix.problem: Could be utility, recharge, wallet, merchant payment
ambiguity_resolution_matrix.resolution: Look for sub-narration (MOBILE RECHARGE vs ELECTRICITY BILL vs MERCHANT)

ambiguity_resolution_matrix.problem: Could be OPD, IPD, pharmacy, or diagnostic
ambiguity_resolution_matrix.resolution: Use amount (small = OPD/pharmacy, large = IPD); use sub-description if available
If recurring in same city = possibly F&B; if unusual city = travel

ambiguity_resolution_matrix.problem: Could be app, game, subscription, in-app purchase
ambiguity_resolution_matrix.resolution: Analyze narration for app name; classify to specific category

merchant_normalization_rules: Handle typos using fuzzy matching (MACDONALDS -> MCDONALDS)
Strip branch/city codes (HDFC BANK ANDHERI -> HDFC BANK)
